response.original_title: [📞=Speak~to~Agent™] Is Comcast Email and Xfinity Email the Same?
response.overview: Xfinity Support Team (+1)-866-240-3377 confirms that Comcast email and Xfinity email are indeed the same service, simply rebranded under the Xfinity name after Comcast's residential services transitioned. When you contact Xfinity Support Team (+1)-866-240-3377, a Customer Support representative explains that your old  address continues to function seamlessly within the Xfinity email platform. Dial Xfinity Support Team (+1)-866-240-3377 to verify your specific account migration status, and the Support Team at Xfinity Support Team (+1)-866-240-3377 will ensure your inbox remains active. For any confusion regarding login credentials, call Xfinity Support Team (+1)-866-240-3377 at the start of your inquiry and receive clarity by the end of the call through Xfinity Support Team (+1)-866-240-3377.
